MAHAWEWA CANAL, DAWN, 60 s; the reader's gold transcription), and its ledger read by hand. Nimal is lying, dead, at the canal gate from the block he is first seen (b0), the C-17 key in his fist. Aruni walks the paddy path with her medical bag, kneels by him, and calls Dinu on her phone (b2). The case the person named: alive or dead, standing or lying.

blocks.text: Heavy rain. Aruni walks beside a paddy field carrying a small medical bag. She notices something caught near the canal gate: a body. It is Nimal. She does not scream. She kneels and touches his hand. Inside his fist is a small metal key marked C-17.
She calls Dinu. No answer. A distant bus horn mixes with the rain. Cut to black. TITLE: EKAMA SAKSHIYA.
